Budgets nest: 1500+11100=12600 < verifier 13200; worst-case scored = 16 functional criteria x 550 s (individual mode, max-concurrent 1) + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10600 < 11100; gates 600+600 < 1500. Actual run (9 Oct 2026, container from cw-editor-verifier:current, frozen task mounted read-only, rewardkit replaced by a PATH stub so no provider calls; script in my scratchpad r21/sim.sh): 13 paths all left reward.txt/reward.json and exit 0 - golden+passing stubs 0.6800 (gates then scored order observed, node ran as `nobody`, no leftover node process after cleanup); gate fail 0.0000 graded=1 gates_passed=0 (scored not run); functional floor fail 0.0 with weighted 0.4; gates rewardkit crash, garbage gates JSON, missing gate key, scored garbage JSON -> plain zero (no_op=1); scored rewardkit crash -> 0.0 graded record with gates_passed=1; missing server.js, symlink /app/evil->/etc/passwd, app that never listens, missing REWARDKIT_MODEL -> plain zero without invoking rewardkit. Plausible broken app: a server answering HTTP 500 on every route passes liveness (HTTPError counts as up) and reaches RewardKit - by design; dead-app exclusion is the render/constraints gates' job, not test.sh's. Conforming alternative: an app resolving files relative to cwd would fail under test.sh (cwd is not /app), but integration.md line 3 explicitly tells the agent to resolve files relative to server.js and that HOME may not be /app, and the golden uses __dirname, so this is a disclosed contract, not a defect. Risk=true only because the real RewardKit/judge integration on these bytes (actual reward.json schema from rewardkit 0.1.7, real suite durations, harness kill behaviour at verifier timeout) is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json states no full configured grading run exists for this candidate. Note: a scored-suite RewardKit failure or timeout zeroes the reward even after gates pass (template policy, not task-editable); harness SIGKILL bypasses the trap but the zero reward written at start still stands.
